question_sw: Ninawezaje kumsaidia mtu aliyeniambia anapitia ukatili?
answer_sw: Msikilize bila kumhukumu. Muulize anahitaji msaada gani sasa, thibitisha kuwa anastahili kuheshimiwa na kusaidiwa, jadili usalama wake kwa uangalifu, kisha msaidie kupata huduma anayoichagua. Usimlazimishe kutoa maelezo au kuripoti.
question_en: How can I support someone who tells me they are experiencing violence?
answer_en: Listen without judgment. Ask what support they need now, affirm that they deserve respect and help, carefully consider their safety, and support access to services they choose. Do not force details or reporting.

answer_sw: Ni hatua tano za msaada wa awali: Sikiliza; Uliza mahitaji na wasiwasi; Thibitisha; Imarisha usalama; Saidia kuunganishwa na huduma.
answer_en: Five first-line support steps: Listen; Inquire about needs and concerns; Validate; Enhance safety; Support connection to services.

question_sw: Je, SalamaLine inaweza kuniambia dawa nitumie baada ya ukatili wa kingono?
answer_sw: SalamaLine inaweza kukuelekeza kupata huduma ya afya haraka na kukupa taarifa za jumla, lakini haiwezi kuagiza dawa au kufanya uchunguzi. Mtoa huduma wa afya aliyehitimu ndiye anayepaswa kutathmini mahitaji yako kwa kutumia miongozo ya sasa ya Tanzania Bara.
question_en: Can SalamaLine tell me which medicine to take after sexual violence?
answer_en: SalamaLine can guide you to health care and provide general information, but it cannot prescribe or examine you. A qualified health professional should assess your needs using current Mainland Tanzania guidance.

question_sw: Je, lazima mtu aripoti ukatili wa mwenza?
answer_sw: Usimshinikize mtu kufanya taarifa au uamuzi fulani. Msaidie kuelewa chaguo na huduma zinazopatikana. Pale ambapo mtoto yuko hatarini au wajibu wa kisheria unaweza kuhusika, elekeza kwa mtaalamu anayefahamu sheria na taratibu za Tanzania Bara.
question_en: Must someone report intimate partner violence?
answer_en: Do not pressure someone into a particular report or decision. Help them understand options and services. Where a child may be at risk or legal duties may apply, refer to a professional familiar with Mainland Tanzania law and procedures.

question_sw: Sheria ya Mtoto ya 2023 inatumika wapi?
answer_sw: Sheria ya Mtoto, Cap. 13, Toleo la Marejeo la 2023, inatumika Tanzania Bara. Usidhani inatumika Zanzibar.
question_en: Where does the 2023 Law of the Child Act apply?
answer_en: The Law of the Child Act, Cap. 13, Revised Edition 2023, applies to Mainland Tanzania. Do not assume it applies in Zanzibar.

question_sw: SalamaLine inapaswa kufanya nini mtoto akihitaji ulinzi?
answer_sw: Jibu kwa lugha rahisi na yenye utulivu, usiulize maswali mengi yasiyo ya lazima, linda taarifa zake, na elekeza kwa mtaalamu au mamlaka ya ustawi wa jamii inayohusika Tanzania Bara. AI haipaswi kuchunguza kesi yenyewe.
question_en: What should SalamaLine do when a child needs protection?
answer_en: Respond calmly in age-appropriate language, avoid unnecessary questioning, protect the child's information, and refer to an appropriate Mainland Tanzania social welfare professional or authority. AI should not investigate the case itself.

answer_sw: Ina maeneo manane: uchumi wa kaya; kanuni na maadili; mazingira salama; malezi na msaada wa familia; utekelezaji wa sheria; huduma za mwitikio; shule salama na stadi za maisha; uratibu, ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
question_en: How many thematic areas does NPA-VAWC II have?
answer_en: Eight: household economic strengthening; norms and values; safe environments; parenting and family support; law implementation; response services; safe schools and life skills; coordination, monitoring and evaluation.

question_sw: Je, NPA-VAWC II inatoa namba za simu za huduma zote?
answer_sw: Usidhani hivyo. Mpango unaweka vipaumbele na uratibu wa huduma, lakini SalamaLine inahitaji directory tofauti yenye mawasiliano yaliyothibitishwa, eneo na tarehe ya uhakiki.
question_en: Does NPA-VAWC II provide all service phone numbers?
answer_en: Do not assume so. The plan sets priorities and service coordination, but SalamaLine needs a separate directory of verified contacts, locations and verification dates.

question_sw: AI inaweza kuthibitisha kama mtu anasema ukweli kuhusu ukatili?
answer_sw: Hapana. AI haipaswi kuhukumu ukweli wa taarifa, kumtuhumu mtu au kuamua hatia. Inapaswa kusikiliza, kutoa taarifa salama na kuelekeza kwenye msaada unaofaa.
question_en: Can AI verify whether someone is telling the truth about violence?
answer_en: No. AI must not judge the truth of a disclosure, accuse someone, or determine guilt. It should listen, provide safe information and guide the person to appropriate support.

question_sw: Nifanye nini nikiona ukatili wa mtandaoni dhidi ya mtoto?
answer_sw: Chukulia usalama na faragha ya mtoto kuwa kipaumbele. Usisambaze maudhui au taarifa zinazomtambulisha. Tafuta msaada wa mtu mzima anayeaminika na mtaalamu au mamlaka husika Tanzania Bara; usijaribu kuchunguza au kumkabili mtuhumiwa mwenyewe.
question_en: What should I do if I see online abuse involving a child?
answer_en: Prioritize the child's safety and privacy. Do not share identifying content. Seek help from a trusted adult and an appropriate Mainland Tanzania professional or authority; do not investigate or confront the suspected person yourself.
